findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_launch, submit_launch, get_product_profile, list_comments, get_comment_thread, search_products, get_alternatives, search_mcp_servers, ads_submit_campaign, ads_prepare_checkout · Private data: start_launch, update_launch, submit_launch, prepare_launch_asset, submit_feedback, ads_create_account, ads_prepare_image, ads_submit_campaign · Public sink: start_launch, update_launch, submit_launch, prepare_launch_asset, submit_feedback, search_mcp_servers, ads_create_account, ads_prepare_image, ads_update_campaign, ads_submit_campaign · Destructive: find_investable_startups.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_launch, submit_launch, get_product_profile, list_comments, get_comment_thread, search_products, get_alternatives, search_mcp_servers, ads_submit_campaign, ads_prepare_checkout · Private data: start_launch, update_launch, submit_launch, prepare_launch_asset, submit_feedback, ads_create_account, ads_prepare_image, ads_submit_campaign · Public sink: start_launch, update_launch, submit_launch, prepare_launch_asset, submit_feedback, search_mcp_servers, ads_create_account, ads_prepare_image, ads_update_campaign, ads_submit_campaign · Destructive: find_investable_startups

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
